rows.title: Safe Withdrawal Rate Calculator
rows.qualifiedReviewRequirement: The current safe-withdrawal success/safety claim has no selected empirical dataset/distribution, failure criterion or calibrated multi-path validation. Qualified quantitative financial-risk applicability review is retained; a compound-interest citation cannot establish a safe rate.

rows.title: Target Heart Rate Calculator
rows.qualifiedReviewRequirement: Age-based target-heart-rate estimates and training intensity need population applicability, screening, measured-HR/HRR alternatives and limitations. Current source/arithmetic does not settle those safety judgments; retain qualified clinical/exercise review.

rows.title: Pregnancy Due Date Calculator
rows.qualifiedReviewRequirement: Pregnancy due-date interpretation needs qualified obstetric applicability/redating review. Complete dating guidance is unavailable and LMP+280 alone cannot establish ultrasound, irregular-cycle or assisted-reproduction policy.

rows.title: Pregnancy Weight Gain Calculator
rows.qualifiedReviewRequirement: Pregnancy weight guidance needs qualified obstetric/nutrition applicability review of BMI cutpoints, plurality, gestational trajectory and special populations. Consumer chart versus underlying guideline scope remains unresolved.

rows.title: Ovulation Calculator
rows.qualifiedReviewRequirement: Ovulation/fertile-window interpretation needs qualified reproductive-health review. A fixed14-day assumption and calendar witness do not establish individual timing, irregular-cycle applicability or validated uncertainty.

rows.title: Conception Calculator
rows.qualifiedReviewRequirement: Conception dating needs qualified reproductive-health review and independently established uncertainty. Inverse calendar arithmetic cannot establish fertilization/intercourse date or paternity, and the approved dating basis is absent.

rows.title: GFR Calculator
rows.qualifiedReviewRequirement: The candidate adult2021CKD-EPI arithmetic is supported, but renal applicability, coefficient profile, input assays/units, exclusions and result interpretation remain clinical judgments. Retain qualified clinician review; no arbitrary output clamp.

rows.title: Sleep Calculator
rows.qualifiedReviewRequirement: Sleep guidance and inverse scheduling need population/age applicability and the distinction between actual sleep and opportunity. A duration subtraction does not establish a universal latency/cycle or clinical recommendation; retain qualified sleep/health review under current evidence.

rows.title: Cooking Time Adjustment Calculator
rows.qualifiedReviewRequirement: No validated food/geometry/appliance time-adjustment thermal model exists in the packet. Qualified food-safety applicability review and calibration are mandatory for the intended safe-cooking interpretation; endpoint temperatures are not a time predictor.

rows.title: Training Heart Rate Calculator
rows.qualifiedReviewRequirement: Training-heart-rate zone selection depends on#404, resting/max-HR methodology, population screening and reviewed thresholds. Current evidence does not establish safe training prescription; retain qualified clinical/exercise applicability review.

rows.title: VO2 Max Estimate Calculator
rows.qualifiedReviewRequirement: The Kline absolute regression/conversion arithmetic is supported, but protocol, healthy30–69 applicability, screening, fourth-quarter HR and uncertainty require qualified exercise/clinical review. Do not substitute a generic postwalk HR or separately fitted relative regression.
